## Specification

- **Population:** Emory thyroid surgery cohort, 1999–2025 (n=10,871)
- **Primary exposure:** Composite "massive" flag = (gland_weight_final_g ≥ 100g) OR (CT or MRI substernal extension) OR (CT tracheal deviation/narrowing/airway compromise)
- **Strata:** is_massive = TRUE (n=2,501) vs FALSE (n=8,370)
- **Primary outcomes:** Demographic + clinical descriptors; any_confirmed_complication_flag (strict-definition: present + def/probable per `canonical_complications_events_v1`); per-component complications
- **Statistics:** Descriptive (n + %); RR + 95% CI (per author-input gap #11 — needs Wald or exact CI added per CLOSEOUT_NOTES item #5)
